answers.justification: The report states blinding of patients was not possible because of the intervention; this supports participant awareness for the assigned oxygenation methods.
The report directly states the ED team could not be blinded to assignment, and ED clinicians delivered the interventions.

Supplement reports some oxygen-device departures from allocated group in both groups, but protocol bytes are unavailable and the cited tables do not establish whether these changes violated protocol or arose because of trial context. The main report notes the protocol exists, but unavailable protocol/registry material leaves the required joint premises unresolved.
unknowns: Protocol consistency and trial-context cause of device changes.

limitations.premise: Whether reported changes in oxygenation devices were protocol-inconsistent and caused by trial context.
limitations.stopping_rationale: Main report and supplementary procedural tables were inspected; protocol is separately cited but unavailable in this captured dossier, and registry bytes were explicitly unavailable. The comparison card's source inventory shows those omissions.

answers.justification: Despite the ITT label, the reported analysis excluded two randomized controls post-randomization (DNR order established afterward and OR intubation). This is an analysis excluding randomized participants rather than an analysis of all randomized participants by assignment. The stated reasons temper certainty about material selection but do not make the reported target population identical to all randomized.
unknowns: Whether endpoint values had been collected for either excluded participant; the report does not say.

answers.justification: Only two of 192 randomized participants (one per listed reason, both controls) were excluded, a small fraction; the Result is a median of a continuous SpO2 measure, not a rare event outcome. Although the post-randomization DNR reason could mark prognosis and the exact values are unknown, substantial alteration of this estimate by two participants is unlikely, hence probable rather than definitive reassurance.
unknowns: Values and prognostic status of the excluded controls are not reported.

counterevidence.implication: The exclusions occurred after randomization and include a post-randomization DNR order, which could signal prognosis; neither participant's endpoint value is disclosed.

answers.justification: The paper identifies the first-attempt lowest SpO2 endpoint and describes the primary van Elteren analysis; it also states protocol was published elsewhere and trial registration. But the cited protocol and historical registry bytes are unavailable, and the report does not establish plan finalization relative to investigator access to unblinded data. The reported primary label cannot fill those gaps; neither probable chronology direction is warranted.
unknowns: Applicable plan content and correspondence for this exact Result; plan finalization and investigator unblinded access chronology.

limitations.premise: Whether this exact reported median-difference result followed an applicable plan finalized before unblinded outcome data were available.
limitations.stopping_rationale: Inspected the report's outcomes and analysis methods, references, and all local supplementary tables; protocol and historical registry sources are recorded unavailable in intake. No source evidence establishes plan content or chronology.

answers.justification: The report presents first-attempt lowest SpO2 as primary and also reports lowest SpO2 across all attempts, but the first-attempt measure is fully reported and the alternative all-attempt measure is also reported. Without the unavailable plan the complete eligible measurement set and any other alternatives cannot be established; there is no direct evidence that the reported first-attempt measure was selected on its results.
unknowns: Whether other eligible SpO2 definitions/time windows were prespecified and whether any were omitted.

limitations.stopping_rationale: The main report's outcome definitions/results and full local supplements were inspected. The separately cited protocol and historical registry bytes are unavailable; the inspected report alone does not resolve the complete eligible set.

answers.justification: The report presents the primary van Elteren comparison and an explicitly post-hoc adjusted quantile regression of the first quartile; the supplement gives both unadjusted and adjusted quartile regression. It also presents PP alongside ITT. These show multiple analyses, but do not establish that an eligible analysis was withheld or selected on its results. With the applicable analysis plan unavailable and more than one possible method, neither selection nor its absence is sufficiently established.
unknowns: Eligible analysis set in the applicable plan and whether any eligible analyses/results were omitted; reason for method choices.

limitations.premise: Whether the selected median-difference result was selected from eligible analysis alternatives because of results.
limitations.stopping_rationale: Inspected primary analysis methods, reported quantitative results and the complete local regression supplement.
